text:
anya: Heads-up 1: onboarding bug thread. A couple of things in the quickstart README are out of sync and causing friction: the cURL example breaks on PowerShell, our Go sample reads REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY, and the Node quickstart says "SDK retries enabled" but Node SDK has them off by default. Getting multiple support tickets.

matt: Seen this too. PowerShell users hit parsing errors because the README uses single quotes for headers and payload. Minimal repro:

```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hey"}'
```

PowerShell treats single quotes literally and won't expand env vars; it also treats JSON quoting differently.

lia: Proposed fix: include both POSIX and PowerShell variants in the README and mark the OS/terminal caveat. Example POSIX (bash/zsh):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hey"}'
```

PowerShell (pwsh):

```
$body = @{ input = 'hey' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" } -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
```

sam: Also let's standardize env var across samples. I found Go snippet uses `os.Getenv("REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY")` which is confusing. We should pick `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere and add a tiny migration note for customers who might still have the old var.

kevin: On the retries point: docs currently say "SDKs handle retries" but that's vague. Quick table suggestion for troubleshooting page: Node: retries = off (how to enable via client opts), Python: retries = 3 by default, Go: retries = 2 by default. Link to the SDK config doc. That should cut down on "why didn't my request retry" tickets.

anya: Agree. Action items: 1) Update README with both cURL variants and a one-line note about terminal differences. 2) Align env var names in all language snippets to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a changelog item about `REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY` deprecation. 3) Clarify retry defaults in quickstart and add link to full SDK retry policy page.

matt: I'll open a docs PR with the two curl examples, change the Go sample to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, and add a changelog entry. Will also add a short "Known terminal gotchas" note.

lia: I'll update the onboarding email snippets and the quickstart README intro so new signups see the PowerShell example.

sam: I'll add the retry defaults table to troubleshooting and create a new short "SDK retry policies" page with examples for toggling retries in each SDK.

devex-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2410 and draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/158 (assigned to @matt).

matt: Thanks. I'll annotate the PR with the migration note and a "how to enable retries in Node" snippet. :thumbsup:

kevin: Once PR merges, let's ping support so they can reference the changelog when replying.

anya: Good plan. Thanks all.
